entities.name: Victoriano Salado Álvarez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victoriano Salado Álvarez was a Mexican writer, a prominent figure on the debate about Modernism in Mexican literature. He also served as secretary of Foreign Affairs in the cabinet of President Porfirio Díaz (1911) and as envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary of Mexico to Guatemala and El Salvador (1911–1912).
